thread:
sam_sales: FYI Sierra pilot (EU) is hitting token throughput ceiling in prod-like tests. Customer expects go-live next Wed. Need ops + pricing to confirm capacity & cost.

devon_engineer: Can you paste the spike logs? Is it steady or bursts? :eyes:

sam_sales: Short bursts during indexing in batches. Here's a snippet from their load test:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:08Z request_id=abc123 qps=120 latency_p50=220ms p95=820ms
2026-03-15T14:02:09Z request_id=def456 qps=240 latency_p50=350ms p95=1.2s
```

eli_infra: Looks like we hit per-node concurrency with current instance type. Quick options: 1) add 2 reserved GPU nodes in EU, 2) temporary cross-region burst to us-west, 3) apply model quantization/shorter seqs. Option 1 is fastest.

maya_revops: Pricing check: if we add 2 reserved A100-ish nodes for Dedicated EU — approximate incremental commit? Need a ballpark for exec.

eli_infra: Ballpark for reserved capacity (2 nodes) ~ €6,500/mo committed. For burst-only on Hosted it's unpredictable. I'll confirm exact SKU.

alesha_security: Any data residency/legal blockers for cross-region bursts? If customer needs EU-only we should avoid option 2.

anna_ciso: Sierra's compliance: EU-only tenancy required. Cross-region won't pass their signoff.

devon_engineer: Short-term performance mitigations we can apply today: enable prefix KV caching + increase request batching window to 40ms. Will drop p95 by ~25% in tests.

ben_eng: I'm happy to push the KV cache toggles. Need a quick config:
```
service.runtime.cache.prefix_kv: true
service.runtime.batch_window_ms: 40
```

sam_sales: Great. Maya, are you good to propose the committed cost and timeline to customer this afternoon? Exec is asking for a one-slide ask.

maya_revops: I'll draft a slide: cost, SLA impact, timeline (24-48h to provision nodes + config changes). ETA 3pm PT.

eli_infra: I'll provision a canary 2-node pool in EU staging tonight and validate. If green, we can schedule Dedicated cutover early next week.

alesha_security: I'll attach a short note for the CISO about isolation guarantees for Dedicated capacity. Will share before 2pm.

sam_sales: Thanks. Action items: maya (cost slide @3pm), eli (provision canary tonight), ben (apply KV cache patch & perf test), devon (monitor load test), alesha (CISO note). Tagging @ops-bot to create ticket.

ops-bot: Created ticket SIERRA-4123 with owners: maya_revops, eli_infra, ben_eng. ETA field set to 2026-03-17. :white_check_mark:

sam_sales: Perfect — I'll update customer after Maya's slide. Keep me posted if perf doesn't improve. :thumbsup:
